value.rationale: The complement-invariant two/four Boolean-layer space is a canonical natural finite instance of the established two-separated layer family. The 15/14 eigenspace split and the four Specht summands are not determined by previously known 29-sphere nonequivariant rank, and they determine rational homology of natural finite-group quotients.
